dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Three prominent 'O' and 'C' shaped structures exhibit soft-edged, light-colored perimeters approximately 15-25 pixels in diameter. The geometry shows a gradual intensity increase from the dark dorsal background to a lighter, irregular ring, enclosing a core of lower-intensity pixels.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: Moderate density of small, low-contrast, light-blue/grey clusters distributed across the dorsal-lateral surface. Concentration is highest along the upper mid-section, with individual blob diameters ranging from 3-8 pixels and lacking distinct internal gradients.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: The centroids of three prominent macro-annuli located on the upper dorsal region form a wide, obtuse triangle with the longest side oriented roughly parallel to the animal's longitudinal axis.
